name: DatoCapital API
description:
Read-only access to companies, directors, and filings across the
major European business registries plus a long tail of offshore
jurisdictions.

Authenticate with a bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer dc_…`).
Most endpoints return JSON; errors follow RFC 9457 problem
documents on `application/problem+json`.
